_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2: guided period close. Declares the canonical FiscalPeriod schema with an open → closing → closed → audit-locked x-openregister-lifecycle: closed is reversible by a period-closer with an audit-trailed close reason, audit-locked is irreversible (auditor only). Additively augments the monolith GLTransaction.post transition with a declarative precondition referencing OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\PeriodCloseGuard:periodOpen, which rejects a posting whose periodId resolves to a FiscalPeriod in state closed or audit-locked (backdating prevention, matches Exact/AFAS/Twinfield). The AI close assistant. Open AP/AR transactions, unreconciled bank receipts, outstanding expense claims. Is computed on demand by OCA\Shillinq\Service\PeriodCloseAssistantService via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll); flags surface as non-blocking warnings (design D3). Seed objects provide five worked example periods (open, closing, closed, audit-locked, reopened) across realistic Dutch administrations. The schema slug FiscalPeriod is the canonical fleet name referenced by AR / AP / VAT / WIP / ICP / R&D-subsidies sibling schemas. Year-end close (opening-balance journal, retained-earnings rollover) is deferred to T3.

FiscalPeriod.title: Fiscal Period
FiscalPeriod.description: An accounting period with lifecycle state, close audit-trail, and task checklist for guided month-end / quarter-end close workflows. The open → closing → closed → audit-locked lifecycle freezes the period for audit; postings against a closed or audit-locked period are rejected by the GLTransaction.post precondition. Canonical fleet schema referenced by AR / AP / VAT / WIP / ICP / R&D-subsidies sibling schemas (per add-shillinq-period-close).

state.description: Lifecycle state. open: postings allowed; closing: close checklist in progress; closed: frozen, postings rejected, reversible by a period-closer; audit-locked: irreversibly frozen by an auditor.

open.label: Open
open.description: Postings dated in this period are accepted. The close workflow has not started.

closing.label: Closing
closing.description: The guided close checklist is being worked through. Mandatory items (open AP / AR) must be resolved before the period can transition to closed.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Frozen for audit. Postings dated in this period are rejected. Reversible by a period-closer with an audit-trailed close reason.

audit-locked.label: Audit locked
audit-locked.description: Irreversibly frozen by an auditor. Late corrections require a compensating journal in the next open period.

startClose.label: Start close
startClose.description: Begin the guided close for this period. Requires the period-closer role.

close.label: Close period
close.description: Freeze the period after the mandatory checklist items are resolved and the bank-reconciliation suspense worklist is empty (payment-control-guards). Sets closedAt / closedBy.

actions.description: Stamp closedAt=now and closedBy=current user on the close transition.

reopen.label: Reopen period
reopen.description: Reopen a closed period for corrections. Requires the period-closer role and a non-empty close reason; appends the prior close to reopenedHistory.

actions.description: Append {closedAt, closedBy, reopenedAt, reopenedBy, closeReason} to reopenedHistory and clear closedAt/closedBy.

lockForAudit.label: Lock for audit
lockForAudit.description: Irreversibly freeze a closed period. Requires the auditor role. Sets auditLockedAt / auditLockedBy.

actions.description: Stamp auditLockedAt=now and auditLockedBy=current user on the audit-lock transition.
